job.job_description:
About the Role




We are looking for a Senior GenAI Developer who can combine strong development skills with hands-on experience in GenAI, LLMs, and Azure to build impactful AI solutions for the Healthcare & Life Sciences (HCLS) domain.

If you enjoy working with LLMs, RAG, AI applications, and emerging GenAI technologies, this could be a great opportunity to work on enterprise-scale AI initiatives.




What You'll Do

Build and enhance GenAI/LLM-based applications using Python.
Develop solutions using RAG, LLMs, and AI agents.
Work with Azure OpenAI and Azure AI services.
Integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications and APIs.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to build scalable and production-ready AI solutions.
Explore and implement new GenAI technologies to solve business problems.



What We're Looking For

47 years of experience in AI/ML, GenAI, or related development.
Strong hands-on experience with Python.
Good experience with Generative AI, LLMs, and RAG.
Hands-on experience with Azure / Azure OpenAI.
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar GenAI frameworks.
Strong exposure to the Healthcare / Life Sciences (HCLS) domain.
Good understanding of APIs, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering.



Good to Have

Experience with Agentic AI / AI Agents.
Exposure to Azure AI Search or vector databases.
Experience taking GenAI solutions from POC to production.
Understanding of enterprise AI security and responsible AI practices.



Key Skills

GenAI | LLM | RAG | Python | Azure | Azure OpenAI | LangChain | LangGraph | Agentic AI | HCLS | Healthcare | Life Sciences
